Model.memoryHook: The model is the intelligence engine, not the whole application.

LLM.memoryHook: LLM is a type of model specialized around language.

Agent.memoryHook: Model = brain; tools = hands; agent = brain + hands pursuing a goal.

Agentic AI.memoryHook: Agentic means the AI can choose and take the next action, not only answer.

Inference.memoryHook: Training changes the model; inference uses the model.

Training.memoryHook: Training changes the weights; prompting does not.

Weights.memoryHook: Weights are learned numbers inside the model.

Token.memoryHook: Models read text in pieces called tokens, not directly as words.

Context.memoryHook: Context = what the model can see right now.

Context window.memoryHook: Context is the contents; context window is the desk size.

Context rot.memoryHook: More context can become less useful when it gets noisy, stale or contradictory.

Prompt.memoryHook: A prompt is one part of context: the instructions or input you give the model.

System prompt.memoryHook: System prompt = higher-priority behavior rules supplied by the application.

Prompt engineering.memoryHook: Prompt engineering improves the instruction; context engineering improves the whole information supply.

Context engineering.memoryHook: Decide what the model sees, when it sees it, and in what form.

Memory.memoryHook: Context is visible now; memory is stored so it can be used later.

Retrieval.memoryHook: Retrieval = find relevant information before asking the model to use it.

RAG.memoryHook: RAG = retrieve evidence, put it in context, then generate.

Embedding.memoryHook: Embedding turns meaning into coordinates useful for similarity search.

Vector database.memoryHook: Embeddings are the vectors; the vector database stores and searches them.

Evidence.memoryHook: Evidence is what can support or falsify a claim.

Grounding.memoryHook: Grounding ties an answer back to evidence instead of letting it float on model plausibility.

Source of truth.memoryHook: When sources disagree, the source of truth is the authority for that kind of fact.

API.memoryHook: API = a contract for software to ask other software to do or return something.

Schema.memoryHook: Schema describes the shape of valid data or arguments.

Tool.memoryHook: A tool is an action the agent can invoke; the API is the software interface underneath or around it.

Tool call.memoryHook: Tool call = structured request; tool = capability being invoked.

Skill.memoryHook: Tool = what the agent can do; skill = reusable know-how for how to do it well.

Capability.memoryHook: Capability is the ability; a tool is one concrete way to expose that ability.

Workflow.memoryHook: Workflow chooses most steps in advance; an agent chooses more steps at runtime.

Harness.memoryHook: Model = engine; harness = car around it; agent = goal-directed system using the car.

Runtime.memoryHook: Harness defines the operating machinery; runtime is where execution actually happens.

Agent loop.memoryHook: Think → act → observe → repeat until a stop condition.

Orchestration.memoryHook: Orchestration coordinates who or what runs; it does not itself provide the intelligence.

Subagent.memoryHook: A subagent is a narrower agent invoked by another agent.

Multi-agent system.memoryHook: Several agents add specialization but also coordination cost.

Planner.memoryHook: Planner decides; executor does; verifier checks.

Executor.memoryHook: Planner decides; executor does; verifier checks.

Verifier.memoryHook: A verifier checks the result independently instead of trusting the agent's confidence.

Reflection.memoryHook: Reflection is self-review; verification uses an independent check when possible.

MCP.memoryHook: API = a restaurant's menu; MCP = a standard way AI clients discover and use many such menus.

Agent-friendly API.memoryHook: Human APIs can be callable; agent-friendly APIs make intent, errors and boundaries explicit.

Autonomy.memoryHook: Autonomy is how far the agent can keep acting without asking.

Bounded autonomy.memoryHook: Let the agent act independently inside a box you define.

Guardrail.memoryHook: Guardrails constrain or validate behavior; prompts merely ask the model to behave.

Sandbox.memoryHook: Sandbox limits consequences even when code is allowed to run.

Eval.memoryHook: Eval = a test of AI behavior; benchmark = a standardized collection of evals.

Benchmark.memoryHook: Benchmark is the test suite used for comparison; an eval can be just one test.

Cache.memoryHook: Cache = reuse previous work instead of recomputing it.

Prompt cache.memoryHook: Prompt cache reuses already-processed repeated context.

Token budget.memoryHook: Token budget is how many text tokens you allow the task to consume.

Compute budget.memoryHook: Compute budget limits processing effort; token budget limits text volume.

Dogfood.memoryHook: Dogfooding = use your own product in real work.

Vibe coding.memoryHook: Describe the change and let AI produce much of the implementation; rigor depends on verification, not the label.

Prompt spaghetti.memoryHook: If every bug becomes another prompt sentence, rules probably belong in code, tools or tests.

Agent spaghetti.memoryHook: Too many agents and handoffs can create more coordination than capability.

Black box.memoryHook: Black box: judge by inputs and outputs; white box: inspect internals.

White box.memoryHook: White box means you can inspect the internal implementation.

Distillation.memoryHook: Teacher transfers behavior; student learns to imitate it more cheaply.

Pruning.memoryHook: Remove low-value structure, then recover accuracy with retraining when needed.

Quantization.memoryHook: Use fewer bits for model numbers to trade some numerical precision for cheaper inference.

Vector.memoryHook: A vector is an ordered list of coordinates; an embedding is a learned vector representation.

Softmax.memoryHook: Softmax turns scores into positive shares that sum to one.

Backpropagation.memoryHook: Backprop computes gradients; the optimizer uses them to update weights.

Gradient descent.memoryHook: Gradient says which way loss rises; gradient descent steps the other way.
